application_window.notes: Opens Oct, closes Nov each year. Phase 1 disbursement ~Jan 20.

amount.description: RM100–RM500 per phase; up to RM2,200/year for B40 households with 5+ children.

additional_rules: B40 (≤RM2,500) and M40 (RM2,501–RM5,000) receive different tiers.
Number of children (num_children) determines tier within B40 band.
Students below 21 do not qualify for Singles category.
Household income = combined income of applicant + spouse.

required_documents: MyKad or MyKid (spouse and children if applicable)
Proof of income (payslip / bank statement 3 months / self-declaration if gig)

steps: Visit bantuantunai.hasil.gov.my during Oct–Nov window
Select Permohonan Baharu STR (new) or Login MySTR (existing)
Update household, income, and dependant details
Upload supporting documents
Submit and save your reference number
Check status at the same portal after Phase 1 (~Jan 20)
application.renewal_notes: Existing recipients must log in and update profile every Oct–Nov window.

application_window.notes: Auto-credited monthly to MyKad. No separate application. Derived from STR status + eKasih tier.

amount.description: Monthly MyKad credit for groceries at 10,000+ MyKasih partner stores.

additional_rules: Auto-derived from STR recipient status. STR must be active for SARA to disburse.
Credit loaded to MyKad chip — only redeemable at registered MyKasih stores.
Cannot withdraw as cash.

required_documents: None — auto-derived from STR eligibility. No separate upload needed.

offline_options: Nearest MyKasih partner store to verify balance
steps: No application needed — SARA credit is auto-applied if you are an STR recipient
Visit any MyKasih partner store (mykasih.com.my for list)
Tap MyKad on terminal at checkout to use balance
application.renewal_notes: Continues as long as STR recipient status is active.

application_window.notes: Feb 2026 disbursement. Auto-credited to MyKad based on NRD records. No registration needed.

amount.description: One-off RM100 MyKad grocery credit for ALL Malaysian citizens aged 18+.

additional_rules: Universal — no income restriction.
Auto-issued based on NRD (National Registration Department) records.
Must have valid MyKad to receive credit.

required_documents: None — automatic based on NRD records.

steps: No action required — auto-credited to MyKad in Feb 2026
If not received by Mar 2026, check sara.gov.my or call 1-800-88-3100

amount.description: Not an aid. Registration unlocks higher-tier SARA, JKM aids, and some zakat programs.

additional_rules: Any Malaysian may register but meaningful tier benefit requires B40 income.
JKM officer may conduct home visit to verify poverty status.
Processing time: 2–4 weeks for home visit + approval.

required_documents: Proof of income (payslip / bank statement / self-declaration)

steps: Visit ekasih.gov.my or nearest JKM office
Submit household and income details
JKM officer schedules home visit (within 2 weeks)
Approval notified via letter or portal — check ekasih.gov.my
application.renewal_notes: One-time registration. JKM may request re-verification if income changes.

application_window.notes: Auto-enrolled for all STR recipients. Coverage period follows STR.

amount.description: Free takaful for B40. Hospitalization: RM50/day (max 14 days/year). Critical illness: RM8,000 one-off. Death/total disability: RM5,000.

additional_rules: Auto-enrolled for all STR recipients aged 18–65.
Claims submitted via Great Eastern portal or hotline, not through AIDa.
Covers 36 critical illnesses including cancer, heart attack, stroke.

required_documents: None for enrollment — auto. For claims: medical report, discharge summary, IC.

steps: No enrollment needed — auto-assigned if you are an STR B40 recipient
To CLAIM: visit mysalam.com.my/claim or call 1-300-1-MySalam
Upload hospital discharge summary or medical report
Claim processed within 14 working days

application_window.notes: Budget 2026 allocation. Application window TBC — check bantuantunai.hasil.gov.my.

amount.description: RM200 one-off e-voucher for Malaysian youth aged 18–20.

additional_rules: Age 18–20 inclusive as of application date.
No income restriction — universal for the age group.
Credit disbursed to approved e-wallet (TNG eWallet or Boost).

steps: Visit bantuantunai.hasil.gov.my during application window
Log in with MyDigital ID or IC + OTP
Select e-Tunai Belia Rahmah application
Confirm e-wallet details for disbursement
Credit appears in e-wallet within 5 working days

application_window.notes: Open year-round. Apply at JKM district office.

amount.description: RM450/month for caregiver of a person with disability registered under JKM.

additional_rules: Caregiver must live with and provide full-time care for the OKU person.
OKU person must be registered with JKM (MyKad OKU status).
One allowance per household — if multiple OKU, only one caregiver claim.
Caregiver cannot be receiving another JKM allowance simultaneously.

offline_options: JKM district office (required for home visit)
steps: Register OKU person on JKM OKU registry if not already done
Register caregiver household on eKasih (if not done)
Visit nearest JKM district office with all documents
Submit JKM18 form + caregiver-specific form
JKM officer will schedule home verification visit
Approval within 4–6 weeks. Monthly payment to bank account.
application.renewal_notes: Annual renewal — JKM case review each year. OKU status must remain active.

application_window.notes: Apply within 6 months of childbirth. No calendar window.

amount.description: RM350 one-time maternity aid for low-income mothers.

additional_rules: Must apply within 6 months of birth.
Child must have birth certificate.
Household must be registered in eKasih poverty database.
Applicable for each qualifying birth (not limited to first child).

required_documents: Hospital discharge or doctor letter confirming birth

steps: Apply at nearest JKM district office within 6 months of birth
Bring all required documents
Submit application form + supporting documents
Approval within 2–4 weeks. One-time payment to bank account.

application_window.notes: Open year-round at JKM district office.

amount.description: Monthly aid scaled by number of dependent children.

additional_rules: Children must be below 18 and in school.
Single parents (divorced, widowed, spouse incapacitated) given priority.
Household must be registered in eKasih.

required_documents: Proof of single parenthood if applicable (divorce cert / death cert / medical cert)

steps: Register household on eKasih (if not already done)
Visit JKM district office with all documents
JKM officer conducts home visit for means testing
Approval within 4–6 weeks. Monthly bank credit.
application.renewal_notes: Annual review — income and children status re-verified.

application_window.notes: Auto-processed on retirement from civil service.

amount.description: Minimum RM250/month supplementary to pension. Amount depends on service grade and years.

additional_rules: Must have served minimum qualifying period (10 years for full pension).
Covers Malaysian civil servants retired from federal government service.
BPEN supplement is in addition to standard pension — targets lower-grade retirees.

required_documents: None — auto-issued on retirement. For queries: IC + pension reference number.

steps: Auto-processed upon civil service retirement
Confirm pension details at jpa.gov.my or nearest JPA office
If supplement not received, contact Bahagian Pencen with IC + pension letter

name.zh: 雪兰莪伊斯兰宗教局每月生活援助

application_window.notes: Open year-round. Apply online or at LZS office.

amount.description: Monthly living aid for asnaf (zakat recipients) in Selangor. Amount varies by asnaf category and household size.

eligibility_criteria.income_band: Below had kifayah (LZS sufficiency threshold — approx RM2,000/month for household of 4)
additional_rules: Must be registered as asnaf with LZS — home visit required for first-time applicants.
Had kifayah threshold calculated by LZS based on household size and region.
Muslims living in Selangor (including Shah Alam, Klang, Petaling Jaya, Subang).

required_documents: Proof of income (payslip / bank statement 3 months / self-declaration)
Proof of address in Selangor (utility bill)
Household members list with IC numbers
Asnaf supporting document (e.g. mualaf certificate if applicable)

steps: Visit zakatselangor.com.my and register as applicant
Select Bantuan Sara Hidup Bulanan
Upload all required documents
LZS officer will schedule asnaf verification home visit
Approval within 4–6 weeks. Monthly bank or cash collection.
application.renewal_notes: Annual renewal — LZS re-assesses asnaf status and household income each year.

name.zh: 雪兰莪伊斯兰宗教局教育援助

application_window.notes: Apply each semester. Typically Jan–Feb (Sem 1) and Jun–Jul (Sem 2).

amount.description: Per-semester education aid for asnaf students in Selangor.

additional_rules: Student must be enrolled in government school, community college, polytechnic, or public university.
Parent/guardian household must qualify as asnaf.
For tertiary: student may apply directly if independent asnaf.

steps: Visit pendidikan.zakatselangor.com.my
Register or log in as LZS asnaf
Select current semester and education level
Upload enrollment letter, results, and parent income documents
Submit before semester deadline (Jan/Jun)
application.renewal_notes: Must re-apply each semester. Auto-approval for returning recipients with unchanged status.

name.en: MAIWP Asnaf Aid via e-MAID Portal
name.zh: MAIWP伊斯兰宗教局贫困援助

application_window.notes: Open year-round via emaiwp.maiwp.gov.my. Walk-in also available.

amount.description: Monthly bantuan sara hidup for asnaf in KL, Putrajaya, and Labuan.

eligibility_criteria.income_band: Below had kifayah (MAIWP threshold — approx RM2,200/month for household of 4)
additional_rules: Resident of KL, Putrajaya, or Labuan only.
First-time applicants require home visit by MAIWP officer.
Had kifayah assessed based on household size and location (higher for urban KL).

required_documents: Proof of income (payslip / bank statement 3 months / self-declaration)
Proof of WP address (utility bill or tenancy agreement)

offline_options: MAIWP Baitulmal office, Jalan Raja Laut KL
application.mobile_app: MoJA (available on Play Store / App Store)
steps: Register at emaiwp.maiwp.gov.my or visit MAIWP Baitulmal office
Select Bantuan Asnaf and your asnaf category
Upload all required documents
MAIWP officer schedules home verification visit
Approval 2–4 weeks. Monthly bank credit.
application.renewal_notes: Annual renewal — MAIWP re-assesses asnaf status each year.

name.zh: 砂拉越伊斯兰公积金贫困援助

application_window.notes: Open year-round. Apply at TBS Kuching or district offices.

amount.description: Monthly asnaf living aid for Muslim residents of Sarawak.

eligibility_criteria.income_band: Below had kifayah (TBS threshold — approx RM1,500/month for household of 4)
additional_rules: Sarawak residents only. Separate from Peninsular Malaysia zakat bodies.
TBS runs independently from LZNK or other federal zakat entities.
Had kifayah threshold typically lower than Peninsular states due to lower COL.

steps: Visit tbs.org.my or nearest TBS district office
Register as asnaf and select Bantuan Sara Hidup
Submit documents and await home visit
Approval 4–8 weeks. Monthly bank credit.
application.renewal_notes: Annual renewal — TBS re-assesses asnaf status.

application_window.notes: Announced for Jul 2026 launch. Check selangorkini.gov.my for confirmed dates.

amount.description: RM300/month cash aid for eligible B40 households in Selangor.

additional_rules: Selangor residents only — confirm via address or MyKad state code.
Income threshold: ≤RM2,500/month household.
Pending official gazette — eligibility criteria may be refined at launch.
Expected start: July 2026.

steps: Monitor selangorkini.gov.my for official launch announcement (expected Jul 2026)
Apply via Selangor state portal when window opens
Upload IC, income proof, and address verification
